name: Mike
description: Self-hosted legal AI workspace for document review, drafting and case-law research, with a Word add-in.
whatItDoes: Lets lawyers review sets of documents in tables, draft and edit with an assistant, and look up US case law. Firms can run it on their own infrastructure.
howItWorks: A Next.js front end and Express backend use Supabase for auth and data and S3-compatible storage for files. The assistant calls Anthropic, Gemini or OpenAI models, or local ones through Ollama, and queries a public case-law API.

requirements.name: LLM provider API key
requirements.description: Anthropic, Gemini or OpenAI key in backend/.env unless only Ollama is used
